title: Grip-trial curvature fails to improve transferred walking-difficulty prediction in older NHANES adults
abstract: Grip-trial curvature did not improve transferred walking-difficulty prediction over maximum strength plus endpoint slope: weighted Brier improvement -0.0002909, joint source/target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.0052406, 0.0016547]. Independent temporal samples from NHANES 2011–12 and 2013–14; selected adults >=60 with six maximal-effort grip trials.
